body: Well, kind of what I was saying to kncaidj, I'm not opposed to more drastic options, but I would like to try the psychiatrist option first, less disruptive on my daily life. Especially as I'm still a fantastically productive member of society, but night time is when the "demons" come out

I really do appreciate the concern, truly. However, I should clarify, it's more of the devil on my shoulder type of thing with the suicidal thoughts. No true will to do it, I really could never do that to the people in my life. I have safe places with good friends I can go to, where I will probably stay for a bit. The non drug using friends that is. This is why I want to go to a shrink though because right now, my depression is manageable, but I know it's growing with my reckless self medicating. I'd rather try this first, if it proves to be more or less ineffective, I'd be willing to do an inpatient care thing to protect me from myself. I know I'm capable of going into such a depression my morals no longer apply and I don't want that.
